title: Five functions, five matches (the wedding programme)
caption:
Five functions, five matches. The wedding programme, read by a matching centre.

Haldi to reception, one piece each, and the ruby-red from N° 01 does the pheras.

Send us your programme on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935, and we’ll match each function.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ the programme · 18k gold tone plated · five functions, no repeats ]

alt_text: A Paithani-purple tile set like a wedding programme card, everything centred: Shade card volume 2, number 08, the programme, then Five functions in large cream capitals, and five matches in blush italics. Five numbered entries run down the middle, Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, Pheras and Reception, with a short gold rule between them, and beside each a pinked fabric swatch holding one gold-tone piece, alternating right and left: brushed huggies on turmeric yellow (right), green baguette huggies on deep green (left), a chunky paperclip chain on a wine sequin fabric (right), a ruby-red tennis bracelet on ivory with a red border (left), and a fine chain with a clear marquise pendant, the Marquise Layering Set, on blush georgette (right).

An ivory slide headed Haldi. In italics: it stains everything, so wear something small. A pair of brushed gold-tone huggies sits in the middle of a large turmeric-yellow silk swatch marked with three soaked-in orange turmeric stains, each with a darker tide line. A gold thread ties them to an ivory tag reading Shade N° 08, matched to Haldi, satin gold tone, about 12 mm. Below: Brushed Gold Huggies, ₹999, satin-brushed rather than mirror-bright.

A pale sage slide headed Mehendi. In italics: your hands are busy for four hours, so dress your ears. A pair of gold-tone huggies set with green baguettes lies on a deep green silk swatch. A gold thread ties the huggies to a tag reading Shade N° 08, matched to Mehendi, green cubic zirconia, not emerald. Below: Baguette Huggies, green, ₹1,199, green baguettes along a gold-tone huggie.

A deep lac-red slide headed Sangeet. In italics: for the dance floor, it catches light from the back row. A chunky gold-tone paperclip chain lies in a loop on a wine-red swatch of overlapping lac-red sequins, a few catching a gold light, its one pavé-set link at the bottom of the loop. A gold thread runs from that link to a tag reading Shade N° 08, matched to Sangeet, one pavé link. Below: Bold Nocturne Chain, ₹1,799, a chunky paperclip chain with one pavé link.

A blush slide headed Pheras. In italics: the long one, ruby-red, all the way round. A gold-tone tennis bracelet of ruby-red baguettes lies on an ivory organza swatch edged with a red and gold woven border. A gold thread ties it to a tag with a red top reading Shade N° 08, matched to Pheras, ruby-red cubic zirconia. Below: Baguette Tennis Bracelet, Ruby, ₹1,699, crosswise baguettes, side by side, about 4 to 5 mm wide.

A lilac slide headed Reception. In italics: the photo line on stage, two layers, already arranged. A photograph pinned to a blush swatch printed tone on tone with leaf sprigs shows the necklaces worn over an open ivory shirt, the face out of frame: a fine chain with one marquise stone above a Y-shaped lariat with small marquise stations. A gold thread ties the print to a pink-topped tag reading Shade N° 08, matched to Reception, two layers, worn at once. Below: Marquise Layering Set, ₹1,599, a fine 40 cm marquise chain over a Y-lariat; then, once for the whole carousel, All five, 18K gold tone plated; and the line Send your programme, WhatsApp +91 95615 57935.
